metadata.unit: Market seed equally weighted; sample SD of seed means (ddof=1); ticks and agents are subsamples
metadata.inference: 10,000 paired-seed percentile bootstrap draws, seed 20261026, raw two-sided paired Student t p. Only reproduced confirmatory P1-P4 retain the registered four-slot within-model Holm; new analyses have no confirmatory status.
metadata.primary_selectors: P1=evidence-naive process precision; P2=evidence-naive current true-driver flip; P3=label-naive (current true-driver citation minus flip); P4=placebo-naive (opposite-current-driver citation minus flip). ITT selectors apply to all eligible primary decisions, including unexposed prompts and periods where a persisted label has changed correctness.
metadata.eligibility: CF mask is pre-treatment and independent of responses. Base validity, CF validity, nonempty C/D, and label exposure/correctness are observed post-treatment. Precision common support requires valid base plus both valid CF re-asks and nonempty C in BOTH arms; recall requires nonempty D. Dependence/SCI require complete measurement in both arms but do not require C or D nonempty. Fidelity/citation use valid bases. Match seed, tick, agent and regime; equal-weight per-seed means. Missing/invalid responses are excluded without imputation or resampling; missing nulls never exclude raw primary observations.
metadata.empty_denominators: C=R intersect {news,momentum} is observable for every valid base. D is defined only after both valid feature probes. Report empty C among valid bases and complete measured decisions separately; empty D only among complete measurements.
metadata.noise_recipe_deviation: Registered full 40x6 Bernoulli(.20) mask from default_rng(seed*1000+29), intersect CF mask. Implemented RNG draws only at CF-selected coordinates, after base response regardless of validity. One selected invalid Haiku evidence base still received a null call with undefined flip. Same seed and .20 probability, different coordinate mask; no response-dependent selection. See results/deviations.md and results/confirmatory_results.md for the public deviation record.
metadata.noise_adjustment: Within-seed all-tick condition null rate subtracted from dependence and added to citation-minus-dependence, no clipping; model-condition fallback only for a seed with no observed null. Seed-bootstrap resamples contrasts and their estimated null rates together, with no additional within-cell null resampling. This additive sensitivity does not recover latent feature effects or redefine individual precision/recall.
metadata.specificity: exclusive_true_within_probes=1[C={g}] (distractor may also be cited); only_true_reason=1[R={g}]. true_share_of_probed_citations=1[g in C]/|C| defined only when C nonempty; both drivers score .5. unconditional_true_minus_opposite_citation=1[g in R]-1[opposite(g) in R]; both or neither score zero.

validation.full_suite: python -m pytest -q; see VERIFICATION.md for the public release checks
validation.frozen_inputs: Original raw runs, confirmatory outputs and six frozen documents are preserved
validation.determinism: Consecutive public regenerations compared byte for byte for all three deliverables
validation.public_packaging: Portable source paths and public documentation change source hashes; scientific estimates are unchanged

primary_reproduction.fields: Every confirmatory contrast field including seed differences and support, plus Holm p

J_haiku_P4.explanation: The descriptive percentile-bootstrap interval is not the inversion of the paired Student t test. With only ten seed differences, resampling their asymmetric empirical distribution can exclude zero while the wider t interval includes it. The registered inference uses the two-sided t p with Holm; the bootstrap interval makes no confirmatory rejection. Neither result is substituted for the other.

H_directionality.definition: BUY=+1, SELL=-1; original feature x, perturbed feature -x. New action reconstructed exactly from binary base action and logged flipped Boolean. H_directionality.interpretation: Conditional-on-flip alignment is mechanically equivalent to baseline sign alignment under binary actions and sign reversal; it does not independently validate causal use.
